# ksp us en home page - route /us/en/home.
#
# Created by the framework from the first recording made on this screen. The id is
# the canonical identity for this application and route (ai/knowledge/canonical.ts),
# so one screen resolves to exactly one file and a later exploration extends this
# one rather than writing a second.
#
# Only what a recording established is written here. Nothing describes what the
# screen is for, because nothing has explored it yet.

page:
  id: ksp__us-en-home
  name: ksp us en home page
  route: /us/en/home

elements:
  my_dashboard_state:
    usage: assertion
    description: dashboard-heading contains "My Dashboard" - read on the UsEnHomePage screen.
    accessible_name: My Dashboard
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: myDashboardState
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'My Dashboard', exact: true })"
  enter_email_field:
    usage: action
    description: Enter email - operated on the UsEnHomePage screen.
    accessible_name: Enter email
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: enterEmailField
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Enter email' })"
  password_field:
    usage: action
    description: Password - operated on the UsEnHomePage screen.
    accessible_name: Password
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: passwordField
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Password' })"
  log_in_button:
    usage: action
    description: Log In - operated on the UsEnHomePage screen.
    role: button
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: logInButton
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Log In', exact: true })"
  hardware_button:
    usage: action
    description: Hardware - operated on the UsEnHomePage screen.
    role: button
    accessible_name: Hardware
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: hardwareButton
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Hardware' })"
  UsEnHomePage_homeLinkState:
    usage: assertion
    description: "Main navigation"
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: homeLinkState
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main navigation' }).getByRole('link')"
    provenance: USER_CONFIRMED
    validation_status: USER AUTHORED — NOT VALIDATED
  LandingPage_logIn:
    usage: action
    description: "Log In"
    page_object: LandingPage
    page_object_method: logIn
    locator_strategy: "page.locator('header').getByRole('link', { name: 'Log In' })"
    provenance: USER_CONFIRMED
    validation_status: USER AUTHORED — NOT VALIDATED
  UsEnHomePage_productHelp:
    usage: action
    description: "Product Help"
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: productHelp
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Product Help' })"
    provenance: USER_CONFIRMED
    validation_status: USER AUTHORED — NOT VALIDATED
  UsEnHomePage_mySupportCaseUnderProductHelp:
    usage: action
    description: "My Support Cases"
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: mySupportCaseUnderProductHelp
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'My Support Cases' })"
    provenance: USER_CONFIRMED
    validation_status: USER AUTHORED — NOT VALIDATED
  product_help_button:
    usage: action
    description: Product Help - operated on the UsEnHomePage screen.
    role: button
    accessible_name: Product Help
    page_object: UsEnHomePage
    page_object_method: productHelpButton
    locator_strategy: "page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Product Help' })"
